title: AP stress study: wrong decisions on the four development seeds

run.id: misses of the AP stress study's development rounds (2026-09-23), transcribed on 2026-10-05 from the authors' stress write-up

not_shipped.reason: the authors' stress write-up of 2026-09-23, the record of the development rounds; it names the authors' working folders, so it does not ship. The provenance archive bench/ap-blind/PROVENANCE.md quotes it under "The development seeds", with this sha256

rerun.detail: The four development seeds rerun from this tree with the shipped harness on today's AP pack: npx tsx bench/ap/stress.ts for the default seed, and the same with --seed fresh1, fresh2 or fresh3. No development rows ship to compare with, so a rerun shows today's decisions; RERUN-2026-10-05.md in this folder records them on that day's pack, 0 wrong on every seed. The five misses were found on the pack of 2026-09-23 and are transcribed from the authors' write-up, which names their working folders and does not ship (its sha256 is under Hashed, not shipped).

misses.description: default seed, case T061: a false hold. OCR-style noise turned "Shipping and handling" into "Shippign and handling", the line was not recognised as freight, and its amount was ignored, so a good invoice failed the total check. The write-up names T061 and T087 and one wrong decision each under OCR letter noise and under all perturbations combined, without pairing them
misses.fixed_by: 2026-09-23 / an amount the parser cannot classify makes the total check abstain; this seed re-run on engine 0.6.0: 0 wrong

misses.description: default seed, case T087: a false hold with the same cause as T061: the misspelt freight line was not recognised and its amount was ignored, so a good invoice failed the total check (one of the two default-seed wrong decisions; see T061)
misses.fixed_by: 2026-09-23 / an amount the parser cannot classify makes the total check abstain; this seed re-run on engine 0.6.0: 0 wrong

misses.description: fresh1 seed, case T084: a false hold. The total "$1 555.63", with a space as the thousands separator, was read as 555.63, so a good invoice failed the total check. Each of the three fresh seeds gave this one wrong decision, on the same case, after the first fix
misses.fixed_by: 2026-09-23 / a space-grouped amount after a currency sign is one number, an unanchored one abstains; re-run on 0.6.0: 0 wrong
